name: neuromorphic_hardware_power_benchmarks
description: A collection of measured power and energy metrics for neuromorphic hardware running representative spiking neural network workloads. The benchmark captures time-series power traces, energy-per-inference, and performance counters to enable cross-device energy-efficiency comparisons. Data is intended for regression and benchmarking analyses to model and predict hardware power behavior under different workloads.
evaluation_method: regression (MAE/RMSE) and energy-efficiency metrics (energy per inference, watts)
reputation: A niche dataset used by neuromorphic hardware researchers and labs for energy-efficiency benchmarking, with modest adoption outside the specialist community.
